versions.content: The function Fr_AbortCommunication shall perform the following tasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx: 1. Invoke the CC CHI command ‘FREEZE’, which immediately aborts communication (if active) and changes to the POC:halt state from any previous POCState. 2. Return E_OK.
